description: One call's passage through a queue, written to the monthly account database as it happens

agent_id.description: The agent who answered, or the supervisor who picked the caller up

answered.description: When the agent answered, in Gregorian seconds

cancel_reason.description: Why the caller left without being connected

cancelled.description: When the caller left without being connected, in Gregorian seconds

ended.description: When the call finished, in Gregorian seconds

joined.description: When the caller entered the queue, in Gregorian seconds

offered_to.description: Every agent this caller was offered to, in order

at.description: When the offer was made, in Gregorian seconds

leg_prefix.description: What the call ids of the legs the offer rang start with, followed by a dash

outcome.description: How the offer ended: cancelled is a ring called off, by the caller leaving, somebody else answering, or the passage ending around it; failed is an offer that never rang or broke, and says why in reason

pickup.description: The phone rung was a supervisor's, for a pickup, and not an agent's

reason.description: Why a failed offer failed: no_endpoints, offer_crashed, offer_down, or the switch's cause

picked_up.description: A supervisor picked the caller up: agent_id is the supervisor, who is not counted as an agent who answered

queue_id.description: The queue the caller waited in

recording.description: The name of the call's recording, when the queue or the agent asked for one: the call_recording document's name, less its extension
